# agentic v0.3.0 - Table of Contents

A composable AI agent runtime

## Modules

- [Agentic](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.md): Agentic — A composable AI agent runtime for Elixir.
- [Agentic.AgentFS](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.AgentFS.md): Agent Filesystem Materialization API.
- [Agentic.AgentFS.Materializer](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.AgentFS.Materializer.md): Behaviour for materializing skills and memories into the agent's filesystem.
- [Agentic.AgentFS.Overlay](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.AgentFS.Overlay.md): Manages temporary overlay directories for agent filesystem materialization.
- [Agentic.AgentProtocol](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.AgentProtocol.md): Behaviour for agent communication protocols.
- [Agentic.AgentProtocol.CLI](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.AgentProtocol.CLI.md): Behaviour for CLI-based local agent protocols.
- [Agentic.CircuitBreaker](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.CircuitBreaker.md): Per-tool circuit breaker for agent tool execution.
- [Agentic.Cldr](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.md): Provides the core functions to retrieve and manage
the CLDR data that supports formatting and localisation.
- [Agentic.Cldr.AcceptLanguage](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.AcceptLanguage.md): Parses HTTP `Accept-Language` header values as defined in
[rfc2616](https://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec14.html#sec14.4).
- [Agentic.Cldr.Currency](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Currency.md)
- [Agentic.Cldr.Locale](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Locale.md): Backend module that provides functions
to define new locales and display human-readable
locale names for presentation purposes.
- [Agentic.Cldr.Money](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Money.md): A backend module for Money.
- [Agentic.Cldr.Number](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Number.md): Formats numbers and currencies based upon CLDR's decimal formats specification.
- [Agentic.Cldr.Number.Cardinal](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Number.Cardinal.md): Implements cardinal plural rules for numbers.

- [Agentic.Cldr.Number.Format](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Number.Format.md): Functions to manage the collection of number patterns defined in Cldr.
- [Agentic.Cldr.Number.Formatter.Decimal](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Number.Formatter.Decimal.md)
- [Agentic.Cldr.Number.Ordinal](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Number.Ordinal.md): Implements ordinal plural rules for numbers.

- [Agentic.Cldr.Number.PluralRule.Range](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Number.PluralRule.Range.md): Implements plural rules for ranges
- [Agentic.Cldr.Number.Symbol](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Number.Symbol.md)
- [Agentic.Cldr.Number.System](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Number.System.md)
- [Agentic.Cldr.Number.Transliterate](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Number.Transliterate.md): Transliteration for digits and separators.
- [Agentic.Cldr.Rbnf.NumberSystem](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Rbnf.NumberSystem.md): Functions to implement the number system rule-based-number-format rules of CLDR.
- [Agentic.Cldr.Rbnf.Ordinal](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Rbnf.Ordinal.md): Functions to implement the ordinal rule-based-number-format rules of CLDR.
- [Agentic.Cldr.Rbnf.Spellout](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Cldr.Rbnf.Spellout.md): Functions to implement the spellout rule-based-number-format rules of CLDR.
- [Agentic.Concurrency.Semaphore](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Concurrency.Semaphore.md): Bounded concurrency semaphore using a GenServer.
- [Agentic.Config](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Config.md): Runtime config surface for `agentic`, loaded from
`Application.get_all_env(:agentic)`.
- [Agentic.CostCalculator](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.CostCalculator.md): Calculates LLM costs from token counts and model pricing data.
- [Agentic.LLM](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.md): Top-level entry point for chat and embedding calls.
- [Agentic.LLM.AdminUsage](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.AdminUsage.md): Pollers for provider organization-level usage / cost APIs.
- [Agentic.LLM.Canonical](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Canonical.md): Canonical model identity. The (provider, model_id) → canonical_id mapping
used to group pathways for the same underlying model weights across
providers (e.g. Anthropic direct, Claude Code CLI, OpenRouter all serve
`claude-sonnet-4`).
- [Agentic.LLM.Catalog](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Catalog.md): Unified model catalog backed by a GenServer.
- [Agentic.LLM.Credentials](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Credentials.md): Resolved credentials for a single provider.
- [Agentic.LLM.Error](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Error.md): Normalized error returned from a transport's `parse_chat_response/3`
(or surfaced from a transport network failure).
- [Agentic.LLM.ErrorClassifier](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.ErrorClassifier.md): Unified error classification combining three sources
- [Agentic.LLM.ErrorPatterns](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.ErrorPatterns.md): Generic pattern tables for classifying LLM provider errors from
response body text. Ported from openclaw's `failover-matches.ts`.
- [Agentic.LLM.Gateway](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Gateway.md): Transparent LLM API proxy that sits between external coding agents
(Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Kimi, etc.) and the actual LLM providers.
- [Agentic.LLM.Model](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Model.md): Shared struct describing a single LLM model.
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.md): Behaviour describing one LLM service provider.
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.Anthropic](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.Anthropic.md): Anthropic Messages API provider.
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.ClaudeCode](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.ClaudeCode.md): Catalog-only Provider wrapper for the Claude Code CLI.
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.Codex](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.Codex.md): Catalog-only Provider wrapper for the OpenAI Codex CLI. See
`Agentic.LLM.Provider.ClaudeCode` for the design rationale.
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.CodingAgentBase](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.CodingAgentBase.md): Macro that synthesizes a catalog-only `Agentic.LLM.Provider`
implementation for an ACP-compatible coding-agent CLI (Cursor,
Gemini CLI, Goose, GitHub Copilot, Kimi, Qwen, …).
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.Copilot](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.Copilot.md): Catalog-only Provider wrapper for GitHub Copilot CLI.
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.Cursor](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.Cursor.md): Catalog-only Provider wrapper for the Cursor agent CLI.
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.GeminiCli](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.GeminiCli.md): Catalog-only Provider wrapper for Google's Gemini CLI. Unlike
Cursor / Goose / etc. (which can route to multiple families),
Gemini CLI exclusively serves Google's Gemini models, so we
override the default seed set.

- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.Goose](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.Goose.md): Catalog-only Provider wrapper for the Goose agent CLI.
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.Groq](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.Groq.md): Groq provider — the Phase 2 forcing function.
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.Kimi](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.Kimi.md): Catalog-only Provider wrapper for Kimi Code CLI. Kimi serves
Moonshot's K2 family natively, plus optional routing to other
providers via its config.

- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.Ollama](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.Ollama.md): Ollama provider — local-first chat and embeddings.
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.OpenAI](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.OpenAI.md): OpenAI Chat Completions provider.
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.OpenCode](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.OpenCode.md): Catalog-only Provider wrapper for the OpenCode CLI. See
`Agentic.LLM.Provider.ClaudeCode` for the design rationale.
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.OpenRouter](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.OpenRouter.md): OpenRouter provider.
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.Qwen](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.Qwen.md): Catalog-only Provider wrapper for Qwen Code CLI.
- [Agentic.LLM.Provider.Zai](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Provider.Zai.md): z.ai (formerly Zhipu) Provider — OpenAI-compatible.
- [Agentic.LLM.ProviderAccount](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.ProviderAccount.md): Per-user, per-provider account state used by the multi-pathway router.
- [Agentic.LLM.ProviderRegistry](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.ProviderRegistry.md): Hybrid provider registration: compile-time list from
`config :agentic, providers: [...]`, runtime `enable/1` and
`disable/1` calls.
- [Agentic.LLM.RateLimit](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.RateLimit.md): Snapshot of rate-limit headers returned by a provider on the most
recent response. Transports populate whichever fields they can parse;
missing fields stay `nil`.

- [Agentic.LLM.Response](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Response.md): Normalized chat response shape produced by every transport.
- [Agentic.LLM.SpendTracker](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.SpendTracker.md): Per-request cost accumulator backed by SQLite.
- [Agentic.LLM.Transport](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Transport.md): Behaviour describing one wire-protocol family used to talk to LLM
providers. A transport is **pure**: it knows how to translate a
canonical request shape into an HTTP request and how to parse the
HTTP response back into the shared `Agentic.LLM.Response` /
`Agentic.LLM.Error` structs. It does not perform any network I/O,
does not look up credentials, and does not implement any
provider-specific business logic.
- [Agentic.LLM.Transport.AnthropicMessages](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Transport.AnthropicMessages.md): Transport for the Anthropic Messages API
(`POST {base_url}/messages`).
- [Agentic.LLM.Transport.Ollama](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Transport.Ollama.md): Transport for the Ollama wire format
(`POST {base_url}/api/chat`, `POST {base_url}/api/embed`).
- [Agentic.LLM.Transport.OpenAIChatCompletions](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Transport.OpenAIChatCompletions.md): Transport for the OpenAI Chat Completions wire format
(`POST {base_url}/chat/completions`).
- [Agentic.LLM.Usage](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.Usage.md): Provider quota / spend snapshot.
- [Agentic.LLM.UsageManager](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.UsageManager.md): Periodically polls every enabled provider that implements
`fetch_usage/1` and caches the latest snapshot. Worth's status
sidebar reads from this cache.
- [Agentic.LLM.UsageWindow](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.LLM.UsageWindow.md): A single rate-limit / quota window for one provider. Anthropic has
rolling 5-hour and 7-day windows; OpenRouter has a single credit
pool; Groq has per-minute RPM caps. They all map to this struct.

- [Agentic.Loop.Context](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Context.md): Shared state threaded through all loop stages.
- [Agentic.Loop.ContextCompression](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.ContextCompression.md): Two-tier context compression: truncation for moderate overflow, LLM-based
summarization for severe overflow.
- [Agentic.Loop.ContinuationDetector](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.ContinuationDetector.md): Detects plan steps and completion signals in LLM text output.
- [Agentic.Loop.Engine](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Engine.md): Composable pipeline engine for agent loops.
- [Agentic.Loop.Helpers](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Helpers.md): Shared utility functions for pipeline stages.

- [Agentic.Loop.Phase](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Phase.md): Phase state machine with per-mode validated transitions.
- [Agentic.Loop.Profile](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Profile.md): Defines loop profiles -- named compositions of stages and config.
- [Agentic.Loop.Stage](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stage.md): Behaviour for loop pipeline stages.
- [Agentic.Loop.Stages.ACPExecutor](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stages.ACPExecutor.md): Executes agent prompts via ACP (Agent Client Protocol).
- [Agentic.Loop.Stages.CLIExecutor](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stages.CLIExecutor.md): Executes agent prompts via CLI-based local agent protocol.
- [Agentic.Loop.Stages.CommitmentGate](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stages.CommitmentGate.md): Intercepts unfulfilled commitments in agent responses.
- [Agentic.Loop.Stages.ContextGuard](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stages.ContextGuard.md): Checks context window usage and triggers compaction if needed.
- [Agentic.Loop.Stages.HumanCheckpoint](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stages.HumanCheckpoint.md): Human-in-the-loop yield stage for :turn_by_turn mode.
- [Agentic.Loop.Stages.LLMCall](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stages.LLMCall.md): Makes the LLM API call and stores the response in context.
- [Agentic.Loop.Stages.ModeRouter](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stages.ModeRouter.md): Mode-aware routing stage. Replaces StopReasonRouter.
- [Agentic.Loop.Stages.PlanBuilder](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stages.PlanBuilder.md): Injects a structured plan-request prompt for :agentic_planned mode.
- [Agentic.Loop.Stages.PlanTracker](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stages.PlanTracker.md): Tracks plan step completion for :agentic_planned mode.
- [Agentic.Loop.Stages.ProgressInjector](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stages.ProgressInjector.md): Injects a system reminder after tool calls to prevent context drift.
- [Agentic.Loop.Stages.ToolExecutor](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stages.ToolExecutor.md): Executes pending tool calls and re-enters the loop.
- [Agentic.Loop.Stages.TranscriptRecorder](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stages.TranscriptRecorder.md): Records session events to a transcript backend for session resumption.
- [Agentic.Loop.Stages.VerifyPhase](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stages.VerifyPhase.md): Post-execution verification stage for :agentic_planned mode.
- [Agentic.Loop.Stages.WorkspaceSnapshot](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Loop.Stages.WorkspaceSnapshot.md): Gathers workspace context and injects it into the conversation.
- [Agentic.Memory.CommitmentDetector](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Memory.CommitmentDetector.md): Detects unfulfilled action commitments in agent responses.
- [Agentic.Memory.ContextKeeper](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Memory.ContextKeeper.md): Per-workspace in-process working memory.
- [Agentic.Memory.FactExtractor](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Memory.FactExtractor.md): Fact extraction from tool results and LLM responses.
- [Agentic.Memory.MemoryManager](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Memory.MemoryManager.md): Retrieves relevant context from the Knowledge store before LLM calls.
- [Agentic.ModelRouter](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.ModelRouter.md): Smart model routing for Agentic with two selection modes.
- [Agentic.ModelRouter.Analyzer](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.ModelRouter.Analyzer.md): Analyzes a user request using a fast, ideally free model to determine
complexity, required capabilities (vision, audio, reasoning, etc.),
and context requirements.
- [Agentic.ModelRouter.Preference](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.ModelRouter.Preference.md): Defines model selection preferences and the scoring logic for each.
- [Agentic.ModelRouter.Selector](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.ModelRouter.Selector.md): Scores and ranks catalog models based on an `Analyzer.analysis()` result
and a user `Preference`.
- [Agentic.Persistence.Knowledge](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Persistence.Knowledge.md): Behaviour for knowledge storage — entries, edges, search, and supersession.
- [Agentic.Persistence.Knowledge.Local](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Persistence.Knowledge.Local.md): File-based knowledge backend.
- [Agentic.Persistence.Knowledge.Recollect](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Persistence.Knowledge.Recollect.md): Recollect-backed knowledge storage backend.
- [Agentic.Persistence.Plan](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Persistence.Plan.md): Behaviour for CRUD operations on structured plans with step-level status tracking.
- [Agentic.Persistence.Plan.Local](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Persistence.Plan.Local.md): JSON file-based plan backend.
- [Agentic.Persistence.Transcript](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Persistence.Transcript.md): Behaviour for append-only session event logging.
- [Agentic.Persistence.Transcript.Local](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Persistence.Transcript.Local.md): JSONL file-based transcript backend.
- [Agentic.Protocol](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.md): Defines transport types for agent communication.
- [Agentic.Protocol.ACP](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.ACP.md): Generic ACP (Agent Client Protocol) implementation.
- [Agentic.Protocol.ACP.Client](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.ACP.Client.md): JSON-RPC 2.0 client over stdio for ACP communication.
- [Agentic.Protocol.ACP.Discovery](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.ACP.Discovery.md): Auto-discovery of ACP-compatible agents on the system.
- [Agentic.Protocol.ACP.Permission](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.ACP.Permission.md): Bridges ACP permission requests to Agentic tool permission system.
- [Agentic.Protocol.ACP.Quirks](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.ACP.Quirks.md): Agent-specific quirks and workarounds for ACP implementations.
- [Agentic.Protocol.ACP.Session](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.ACP.Session.md): ACP session lifecycle management.
- [Agentic.Protocol.ACP.Types](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.ACP.Types.md): ACP (Agent Client Protocol) type definitions and conversions.
- [Agentic.Protocol.ClaudeCode](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.ClaudeCode.md): Claude Code CLI protocol implementation.
- [Agentic.Protocol.Codex](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.Codex.md): Codex CLI protocol implementation (one-shot mode).
- [Agentic.Protocol.Error](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.Error.md): Protocol-specific errors
- [Agentic.Protocol.LLM](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.LLM.md): LLM protocol implementation that wraps existing callback-based LLM calls.
- [Agentic.Protocol.OpenCode](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.OpenCode.md): OpenCode CLI protocol implementation.
- [Agentic.Protocol.Registry](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.Registry.md): Registry for agent protocol implementations.
- [Agentic.Sandbox.PathValidator](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Sandbox.PathValidator.md): Validates that tool-requested paths stay within an explicit allowlist of roots.
- [Agentic.Sandbox.Platform](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Sandbox.Platform.md): OS-level sandbox capability detection.
- [Agentic.Sandbox.Runner](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Sandbox.Runner.md): Cross-platform sandbox wrapper for agent subprocesses.
- [Agentic.Skill.Analyzer](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Skill.Analyzer.md): Analyzes skill content to determine model tier requirements.
- [Agentic.Skill.CoreSkills](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Skill.CoreSkills.md): Manages bundled core skills that ship with every agent.
- [Agentic.Skill.Parser](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Skill.Parser.md): Parses SKILL.md files with YAML frontmatter and markdown body.
- [Agentic.Skill.Service](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Skill.Service.md): Workspace-scoped skill management.
- [Agentic.Storage.Backend](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Storage.Backend.md): Behaviour for storage backend implementations.
- [Agentic.Storage.Context](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Storage.Context.md): Bundles a storage backend module with its config for a specific workspace.
- [Agentic.Storage.Local](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Storage.Local.md): Local filesystem storage backend.
- [Agentic.Strategy](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Strategy.md): Behaviour for orchestration strategies.
- [Agentic.Strategy.Default](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Strategy.Default.md): Identity strategy. Passes opts through unchanged, matching current
`Agentic.run/1` behavior exactly.

- [Agentic.Strategy.Experiment](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Strategy.Experiment.md): Experiment runner for head-to-head strategy comparison.
- [Agentic.Strategy.Registry](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Strategy.Registry.md): Process registry for strategy modules.
- [Agentic.Subagent.Coordinator](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Subagent.Coordinator.md): Per-workspace subagent coordinator.
- [Agentic.Subagent.CoordinatorSupervisor](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Subagent.CoordinatorSupervisor.md): Dynamic supervisor for per-workspace Coordinators.
- [Agentic.Subagent.DelegateTask](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Subagent.DelegateTask.md): Tool definition for delegating tasks to subagents.
- [Agentic.Telemetry](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Telemetry.md): Centralized telemetry helpers for Agentic.
- [Agentic.Telemetry.Aggregator](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Telemetry.Aggregator.md): GenServer that maintains running aggregates of orchestration telemetry events.
- [Agentic.Tools](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Tools.md): Tool definitions and execution for the agent loop.
- [Agentic.Tools.Activation](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Tools.Activation.md): Tracks which external tools are "activated" (promoted to first-class
tool schemas) in the current agent session.
- [Agentic.Tools.Gateway](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Tools.Gateway.md): Gateway tools for lazy tool discovery and execution.
- [Agentic.Tools.Memory](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Tools.Memory.md): Memory tools for the agent: query knowledge store, write entries,
and use in-process working memory (ContextKeeper).
- [Agentic.Tools.Skill](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Tools.Skill.md): Skill management tools for the agent: list, read, search, install, remove, analyze.

- [Agentic.Workspace.Identity](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Workspace.Identity.md): Workspace identity file detection and status.
- [Agentic.Workspace.PathValidator](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Workspace.PathValidator.md): Validates workspace paths are within the allowed base directory.
- [Agentic.Workspace.Service](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Workspace.Service.md): Manages workspace file structure and policy.
- [Agentic.Workspace.Templates](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Workspace.Templates.md): File templates for workspace initialization.

- Exceptions
  - [Agentic.Protocol.Error.NotFound](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.Error.NotFound.md): Raised when a requested protocol is not registered.
  - [Agentic.Protocol.Error.SessionError](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.Error.SessionError.md): Raised when a protocol session encounters an error.
  - [Agentic.Protocol.Error.Unavailable](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Agentic.Protocol.Error.Unavailable.md): Raised when a CLI-based protocol binary is not found or not executable.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix agentic.routes](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Agentic.Routes.md): Inspect multi-pathway model routing decisions.
- [mix agentic.test_setup_recollect](https://agentic.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Agentic.TestSetupRecollect.md): Sets up the Recollect test database for integration tests.
